metadata.description: Real Agent's plugins for estate agents: the Real Agent knowledge base each firm keeps in its own Supabase project, its organisational knowledge base (OKB), and the agents that work in it.

plugins.name: real-agent
plugins.description: Two agents every firm gets with Real Agent, for its Real Agent knowledge base, the organisational knowledge base (OKB): the database operator, for every member of staff, and the database admin, for the firm's administrator.

plugins.name: okb
plugins.description: Lets each person work in their firm's Real Agent knowledge base, its organisational knowledge base (OKB), in the firm's own Supabase project, within their own permissions: records, files and their search, the glossary and data dictionary, boards, graphs and printed PDFs.

plugins.name: business-analyst
plugins.description: Sets up Real Agent for a firm: its Real Agent knowledge base, the organisational knowledge base (OKB), in its own Supabase project. Then interviews its people about their routines, one routine at a time, and saves each confirmed routine in the knowledge base as a model of how the work is done today.
